newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight starts week active.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight starts week active.

text.p: The sugar freight market started the week with on a fairly busy note with several some fresh enquiries and fixtures reported.
CSR 20,000 bulk cargo Queensland to Ho Chi Minh City 31 Jly-9 August ideas $19.
Fiji Sugar Marketing 18,000 five percent more from Fiji to Savannah to Gramercy for 5-15 August.
Cargill 12,500 tonnes bulk Thailand Japan 20-25 July.
Trans-Ocean Navigation 14,000 bagged from Santos or Paranagua to Hodeidah mid-Aug.
Sugar Chartering 14,000 bulk La Romana to US Gulf prompt.
Benham 12,000 - 15,500 bagged from Manzanillo to Peru end July.
South Africa Sugar Association 34,000 bulk Durban-Jeddah $15.00.
Cargill 14,000 bagged Santos to Lagos, Baltic, Black Sea, Mediterranean, Red Sea, Indian Ocean.
Cargill 18,000-20,000 bulk North Brazil to US Gulf of Atlantic end July.
Last week's fixture by Fiji sugar marketing of 16,200 bulk Fiji to Portugal was fixed at about $35.00, brokers said.
